derived_by: Sub-A, hand reading of PGF v1 tables and hand arithmetic

source.section: 4. Likelihood, Severity and Residual-Risk Tiers — Residual-Risk Tier Matrix (track (a))
4. Residual-Risk Tier Matrix — 'PanEuropean adopts the template matrix without relaxation'
Appendix to Part B — matrix reproduced

matrix.orientation: rows = severity level, columns = likelihood level
properties_checked_by_hand: Part A template values and Part B values are identical in all 16 cells
Severity-led floors (SR-08-A-PRINC-SEVLED): every Catastrophic cell >= High; every Significant cell >= Medium
Monotone: non-decreasing along every row (left to right) and every column (top to bottom) under Low < Medium < High < Critical
Critical appears only in Catastrophic x {High, Near-certain}

source.section: 4.3 Severity — Step 3 mapping table and contiguity note
4.3 Severity — Step 2 (index = w_B·B + w_C·C + w_D·D + w_E·E + w_G·G, floor 0)

severity_bands.rule: index < 3.5 Minor; 3.5 <= index < 6.5 Moderate; 6.5 <= index < 8.5 Significant; index >= 8.5 Catastrophic; no rounding

probes.trace: upper range limit with default weights: B 7 + C 4 + D 2 + E 2 + G 2 = 17 (SR-18-A-FACTOR-CAPS)
upper range limit with every weight at the corridor maximum 2.0: 2 x 17 = 34 (SR-18-A-PASSPORT weight corridor 0.5-2.0)

raw_sum_probes.trace: index = max(0, -1) = 0 (floor 0); a negative raw sum can arise only through the data-age modifier -1 (ambiguity A-03)

invalid_probes.trace: not a real number; no band is assigned; never defaults to Minor
outside any finite factor range; no band
missing index; calculation not complete; never defaults to 0/Minor

weighted_severity.arithmetic: exact decimal arithmetic on the stated weights; PGF-18 states that fractional indices map to exactly one level 'without rounding'

probes.trace: 0.7 x 2 + 0.7 x 3 = 1.4 + 2.1 = 3.5 exactly -> Moderate. Binary floating point gives 3.4999999999999996 and would wrongly yield Minor (ambiguity A-06)
0.7 x 6 + 1.15 x 2 = 4.2 + 2.3 = 6.5 exactly -> Significant (binary floating point gives 6.499999999999999)

severity_floors.rule: whatever the index, at least Significant where (i) identifiable special-category data are disclosed to an unlimited audience or used to make decisions about the person, or (ii) there is a realistic risk of physical harm; floors only raise

probes.trace: 5 -> Moderate; floor (i) -> at least Significant -> Significant

likelihood_bands.rule: index = L1+L2+L3+L4, L1..L3 in {0,1,2,3}, L4 in {0,1,2}; 0-3 Low, 4-6 Medium, 7-8 High, 9-11 Near-certain

invalid_probes.trace: L4 = 3 outside its domain {0,1,2} (the L4 '3' cell is '—'); index 12 is unreachable
L1 = 1.5 not an integer; the index is always an integer
L3 missing; never defaults to 0; no level assigned

likelihood_override.rule: if L3 = 3 and L2 >= 2 then level = max(level_from_index, High)

probes.trace: 0+2+3+0 = 5 -> Medium; L3=3, L2=2 -> at least High -> High

likelihood_override.note: Whether the override also applies to the inherent likelihood (where L3 is set to 3 by definition) is ambiguity A-01; PGF-19 DPIA-FL-01 S2 reports inherent 6 -> Medium with L2 = 2.

probes.trace: PASS with indicator > 1 cannot arise: an indicator above 1 implies a weighted metric above its threshold, i.e. FAIL (SR-18-A-PET-INDICATOR); the input is inconsistent
INCOMPLETE (G-M5): not assessed, no likelihood level; indicator ignored
FAIL: as-proposed likelihood High regardless of indicator 0.3
FAIL reproduced (persists in every repetition, whole CI beyond threshold): internal routing rule -> Near-certain (as-proposed)

source.section: 3.4 Factor F — track (b) index table and floor

track_b_bands.rule: index = max(0, sum of subfactor scores); 0-1 Minor, 2-3 Moderate, 4-5 Significant, >= 6 Catastrophic; range 0..7 (regime 0..1 + financial 0..3 + reputational 0..3 + sandbox -1..0)

end_to_end.trace: 9 -> Catastrophic; 0 -> Low; severity-led floor cell -> High

notes: Grid derived by reading the PGF-08 tables cell by cell. Probes with result 'invalid' or 'incomplete' must not produce a level; producing Minor/Low/PASS for them is a defect. Floating-point probes W5/W6 encode the reading that PGF-18's 'without rounding' requires exact arithmetic on stated decimal weights (A-06).
